# Test: apx lint for OpenAPI has a built-in operationId check.
# The check is native Go. It does not need spectral, so each assertion below
# holds with and without spectral on the PATH. The opt-out
# (--operation-ids=false) has its test in internal/validator.

# A missing operationId fails
! exec apx lint --format openapi missing.yaml
stderr 'GET /widgets/\{id\}: operationId is missing'

# A repeated operationId fails
! exec apx lint --format openapi duplicate.yaml
stderr 'operationId "widgets" is not unique: GET /widgets, GET /widgets/\{id\}'

-- missing.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Widgets
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /widgets:
    get:
      operationId: listWidgets
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ok
  /widgets/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get one widget
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ok
-- duplicate.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Widgets
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /widgets:
    get:
      operationId: widgets
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ok
  /widgets/{id}:
    get:
      operationId: widgets
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ok
